info.title: Bota API
info.description: API for capturing, ingesting, and processing offline conversations via AI wearable devices

get.description: Read only the verified project secret/restricted key context without a business-read scope. Secret scopes are null with project_secret mode; restricted scopes are exact granted metadata, including an empty array. Other operation-specific admission still applies. The test-mode flag does not certify test/live data or billing isolation. No human identity, key material, expiry or OAuth authority is returned. Error and header metadata describes the authenticated non-playground middleware chain. Header presence is conditional and does not imply cross-origin browser access; CORS policy applies.

AuthenticatedReadXRequestId.description: Opaque request correlation ID when request-ID middleware runs. Caller-supplied values are accepted; no generated-ID format is guaranteed.

AuthenticatedReadRateLimitPolicy.description: Standard limiter policy when evaluated, currently draft-6 quota/window syntax. This header does not establish billing-tier admission.

AuthenticatedReadRateLimitLimit.description: Standard limiter request quota when evaluated.

AuthenticatedReadRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the standard limiter window when evaluated.

AuthenticatedReadRateLimitReset.description: Seconds remaining until the standard limiter window resets, not an epoch timestamp.

AuthenticatedReadXRateLimitLimit.description: Billing-tier request quota only when billing initializes, a limited tier resolves and its check succeeds; omitted for unlimited tiers, disabled billing or check failures.

AuthenticatedReadXRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining billing-tier requests when that limited-tier check succeeds.

AuthenticatedReadXRateLimitReset.description: Billing-tier window reset as Unix epoch seconds, unlike the relative RateLimit-Reset header; present only after a limited-tier check succeeds.

AuthenticatedReadXRateLimitTier.description: Resolved billing tier when a limited-tier check succeeds. Unknown tier names can be returned; no closed tier enum is guaranteed.

streaming_chunk_kb.description: Stored target; released compatibility firmware uses a 512 KB full-chunk target

streaming_flush_interval_seconds.description: Partial-chunk timer in seconds; 0 disables time-based flush

daily_data_limit_mb.description: Stored target; not enforced by released compatibility firmware

allow_roaming.description: Stored target; not enforced by released compatibility firmware

pause_on_low_battery.description: Stored target; not enforced by released compatibility firmware

off_peak_hours.description: Stored target; not enforced by released compatibility firmware

file_size_bytes.description: Integer or canonical signed decimal string (up to 19 digits); raw PostgreSQL BIGINT values are strings. Preserve the string to avoid precision loss.

content_sha256_verified_at.description: Successful asynchronous server-side verification time; plaintext device OGG/Opus also requires valid media and declared length; null is not proof of failure

upload_contract.description: Server-owned upload contract. Coordinated and BYO flows have their own admission and recovery contracts; their presence is not proof of enabled deployment. Not accepted on ordinary create.

recording_uuid.description: Stable device-side logical recording identity used for retry-safe creation

recording_generation.description: Generation of the stable logical recording identity

audio_url.description: Pre-signed URL when a storage key is assigned; URL presence does not prove that the object exists or upload completion was accepted
Pre-signed URL when a storage key is assigned; URL presence does not prove object existence or accepted upload completion

marker_required.description: True only for a job bound to a verified published marker set; not a completion or deletion proof

transcript_version.description: Immutable server-issued version after marked transcription completion; null for ordinary legacy rows

confidence.description: Number or raw PostgreSQL DECIMAL(4,3) string with three fractional digits, including the PostgreSQL NaN sentinel. No probability-range constraint is imposed.

snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of raw canonical snapshot bytes, without a domain prefix

transcription_version.description: Summary context pins the completed transcription version

transcript_segment_indices.description: Zero-based matching ASR intervals; empty means no matching transcript text, not inferred speech

marker_required.description: True only for a job bound to a verified published marker set; not a completion or deletion proof

AuthenticatedReadOrganizationAccessQuara.description: Organization access is temporarily locked while an organization deletion request is active. The organization owner may cancel the request through the dashboard during the grace period.

Cache-Control.description: Quarantine responses must not be cached.

bearerAuth.description: API key (sk_live_*, sk_test_*, rk_*), device token (dtok_*), or command-bound reset completion credential (rct_*; exact factory-reset ACK only)
